acceptable_evidence: Direct surveyed vertical relation between G1 structural datum and the actual common foundation/base plane at an identifiable location; or a primary section with explicitly registered endpoints tying the two datums.
preferred_low_disruption_route: Level survey through an accessible semibasement/foundation interface if the actual structural base line is observable.
alternative_route: Targeted local exposure/measurement approved by the responsible technician where direct structural datum is not otherwise observable.
promotion_condition: A traceable measurement or direct dimension must identify both endpoints and uncertainty; only then assign numeric ZF_COMMON.
do_not_do: Do not derive ZF_COMMON from the historical 1.00 m below ground plus an arbitrary/current ground point.

acceptable_evidence: Direct primary construction detail or local in-situ stratigraphic measurement identifying layer interfaces and thicknesses at representative PT locations.
preferred_low_disruption_route: Use existing openings/accessible edges or already exposed construction details before creating new destructive access.
alternative_route: Small targeted core/test opening under technician control if required and compatible with finishes/services/structure.
promotion_condition: Each numeric thickness must be tied to location, method, photo/evidence and applicability zone; variability must be recorded rather than averaged silently.
do_not_do: Do not assume one layer stack or thickness for the entire PT from a single unqualified point.

target_claim: Ground-supported versus structurally supported PT build-up
acceptable_evidence: Direct structural observation/detail establishing whether the PT surface build-up bears continuously on fill/ground or includes a spanning structural slab/member system, with local exceptions mapped.
preferred_low_disruption_route: Inspect accessible edges, service openings, stair/threshold transitions and construction details; reconcile with TAV-06E geometry.
alternative_route: Targeted local exposure or non-destructive investigation capable of distinguishing support mechanism.
promotion_condition: Support mechanism and tributary structural zones are explicitly mapped; only structurally transferred portions may feed frame/foundation gravity loads, while mass treatment is separately justified.
do_not_do: Do not load all fill/pour/screed weight onto foundation beams/frame by default.

target_claim: Unit weights/densities needed for PT permanent loads and seismic mass
acceptable_evidence: Primary material specification, historical construction record, representative sample/test, or explicitly declared modeling assumption with bounded sensitivity where direct evidence is unavailable.
preferred_low_disruption_route: Recover documentary material descriptions first; use measured thickness with conservative transparent density assumptions only at the later modeling gate if professional judgment accepts them.
alternative_route: Representative material sampling/testing where load sensitivity justifies it.
promotion_condition: Every adopted unit weight is classified DOC/MIS/RIF/INF and sensitivity is documented if not directly measured.
do_not_do: Do not transfer foundation-concrete properties or unrelated historical densities to PT layers by analogy.

target_claim: Direct proof of a-d participation/omission in original calculation
acceptable_evidence: Original frame diagrams, load-input pages, calculation sheets, index/appendix or equivalent primary calculation evidence that can be mapped to the terrace/a-d subsystem.
preferred_low_disruption_route: Recover the previously photographed 12 calculation pages or the complete historical calculation dossier from project/paper archives.
alternative_route: Search external technical/administrative archives only when a concrete repository/source lead exists.
promotion_condition: Source must identify the relevant historical model scope sufficiently to demonstrate presence, absence or non-participation; omission may then be promoted from RIF to DOC.
do_not_do: Do not treat missing repository files, later-construction character or derived infographics as proof of omission.

acceptable_evidence: Original geotechnical/geological report, borehole/test records, groundwater data, later site investigations or equivalent traceable site-specific evidence.
preferred_low_disruption_route: Inventory owner/condominium/technician/collaudo/project archives before commissioning new tests.
alternative_route: Relevant public/administrative archive retrieval where document existence/location is identified.
promotion_condition: Each recovered source is registered with date, location, investigation method, stratigraphy/parameter scope and applicability to the current building footprint.
do_not_do: Do not substitute the historical allowable bearing pressure for a current site model.

target_claim: Close remaining stratigraphy/groundwater/strength/stiffness gaps if documents are inadequate
acceptable_evidence: Investigation program justified from the residual matrix, building footprint, site variability, accessibility and any recovered historical evidence; resulting in traceable site-specific parameter data.
preferred_low_disruption_route: Define the minimum evidence-gap-driven campaign after M1F-EXT-006 document recovery.
alternative_route: Expand the campaign only where variability/results show that the initial program is insufficient.
promotion_condition: Program and results close the specific M1F-GEO requirement rows with traceable characteristic/model parameters; test counts are justified, not generic.
do_not_do: Do not prescribe a fixed generic number/type of tests before documentary recovery and site/access assessment.

acceptable_evidence: All current repository/source inventories are closed; unresolved claims are assigned to one of the tasks above with explicit promotion criteria.
preferred_low_disruption_route: Use this queue as the only autonomous continuation point for M1-F unless a new primary source enters the repository.
alternative_route: A formal small-scope reopen may be created for a newly conflicting primary source.
promotion_condition: No unresolved M1-F item triggers restart of geometry, foundation section or reinforcement transcription.
do_not_do: Do not restart closed M1-F documentary fronts merely because an external-evidence item remains open.
